immutability_rule: The bound result, manifest, program artifact, program receipt, and authority receipt are preserved byte-for-byte. This separate erratum narrows interpretation and must accompany them.

deviations.description: The runner permuted validation labels as well as fit labels for shuffle-map selection. The preregistered null names a permutation of fit labels, so the saved shuffle arm is descriptive rather than the literal registered null.
The rare-vocabulary mask was derived from compiler_final. Final rows were therefore used to define novel-frequent/novel-rare strata, contrary to the no-final-threshold rule.
The preregistration requires identical gauge CE, but the runner accepted a 2e-5 tolerance. Observed maximum row-CE difference was 1.1920928955078125e-6, nonzero.
The saved integrity boolean was assigned from gauge_pass rather than an explicit conjunction of every registered integrity criterion.

licensed_descriptive_claim: On the frozen ship and 192 fresh final rows, the poison-gated affine maps fail in global CE: QNN gains 0.010115 nats, NQN loses 0.098182, and QQN loses 0.050548. QQN is also worse than the raw mean and saved shuffle arms. The complete raw row analysis localizes the dominant failure to MLP1. This is descriptive authoritative evidence rejecting this v1 z-only Euclidean affine interface, not a clean registered-gate pass/fail.
